lines.en: : The time has come for me to save my family. I will complete my journey and defeat the final boss of Sensei-Quest.
lines.zh: : 是时候去拯救我的家人了。我要走完这趟旅程，打败《Sensei 大冒险》的最终 boss。
{i}Sensei 的 HP 提升到了 50！{/i}

lines.en: : That would have been really helpful like four boss fights ago.
lines.zh: : 这玩意儿要是早在四场 boss 战之前给我，那该多有用了。

lines.en: {i}With a head full of hopes and dreams, our brave hero sets off toward Meowri’s house.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}满怀着希望与梦想，我们勇敢的英雄出发前往 Meowri 的家。{/i}

lines.en: {i}In the final version of the game, a forty-five minute cutscene depicting his journey will be shown here.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在游戏的最终版本中，这里会播放一段四十五分钟的过场动画来描绘他的旅程。{/i}

lines.en: {i}For now, please accept this picture of a binturong.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}现在，请先收下这张熊狸的照片。{/i}

lines.en: : What the hell is a binturong?
lines.zh: : 熊狸到底是个什么鬼东西？

lines.en: {i}SENSEIDEX: The binturong, also known as a bearcat, is a carnivorous mammal native to south and southeast Asia. Their status in the wild is currently assessed as “vulnerable.”{/i}
lines.zh: {i}SENSEIDEX：熊狸，又名「bearcat」，是一种原产于南亚和东南亚的食肉哺乳动物。其野生种群现状目前被评估为「易危」。{/i}

lines.en: : Since when do I have a Senseidex and why is the only entry in it an endangered animal?
lines.zh: : 我什么时候有了个 SENSEIDEX？而且为什么里面唯一的条目还是一种濒危动物？

lines.en: {i}SENSEIDEX: Correction — the binturong is not “endangered.” It is currently “vulnerable,” as previously mentioned. Please pay attention, idiot.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}SENSEIDEX：更正——熊狸并非「濒危」。如前文所述，它目前的状态是「易危」。请注意听讲，笨蛋。{/i}

lines.en: : And why is it so rude?
lines.zh: : 还有，它说话为什么这么冲？

lines.en: {i}After the forty-five minute walk to Meowri’s house concludes, Sensei knocks on Meowri’s door and prepares himself to leave a survey detailing how he thinks the Shiawase Group can improve Sensei-Quest!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在长达四十五分钟的步行之后，Sensei 敲响了 Meowri 家的门，并做好了留下问卷调查的准备——问卷里详细写着他认为 Shiawase 集团该如何改进《Sensei 大冒险》！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Please note that Sensei will receive 50 RAINBOW COINS for completing this survey!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}请注意，完成这份问卷后 Sensei 将获得 50 枚彩虹币！{/i}

lines.en: : But I’ve already passed the point of no return. What am I even supposed to do with those now?
lines.zh: : 可我已经走过不归路了。现在给我这些还有什么用？

lines.en: {i}You can use them in new game plus — where all encounters are ten times harder with mild variations.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你可以在二周目里使用——那里的所有遭遇战难度都会翻十倍，还会有细微的变化。{/i}
: 哦，我的天，别啊。
{i}Sensei 抵达了 Meowri 的家！{/i}
: 这是一家麦当劳。

lines.en: : Hello again, brave hero! Did you enjoy your journey?
lines.zh: : 又见面了，勇敢的英雄！你喜欢这趟旅程吗？
: 不喜欢。
: 真的吗？为什么呢？

lines.en: : Probably because like 95%% of enemy attacks dealt the same amount of damage while {i}my{/i} attacks needed to be made in an extremely specific order with no logic to it whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为差不多 95%% 的敌人攻击造成的伤害都一模一样，而{i}我的{/i}攻击却必须以极其特定的顺序打出，而且毫无逻辑可言。

lines.en: : The boss health bars never moved, I could never see what my HP or PREMIUM CURRENCY levels were, there were only two vendors and three BGM tracks, and like all of the non-boss enemies were slimes.
lines.zh: : boss 的血条从来不动，我永远看不到自己的 HP 和高级货币余额，整款游戏只有两个商人、三首 BGM，而且几乎所有非 boss 敌人都是史莱姆。
: 您的反馈已记录！

lines.en: : Please accept these 50 RAINBOW COINS as thanks for playing Sensei-Quest!
lines.zh: : 请收下这 50 枚彩虹币，感谢您游玩《Sensei 大冒险》！

lines.en: : I want all of my time back. No one told me I was going to have to beat an entire RPG just to get on with the Halloween update.
lines.zh: : 我想把花掉的时间全部要回来。没人告诉过我，为了推进万圣节更新，我还得先通关一整部 RPG。

lines.en: : What’s that? You’re ready to beat the game? Why didn’t you just say so?!
lines.zh: : 什么？你已经准备好通关了？那你干嘛不早说嘛？！

lines.en: {i}Meowri has removed the {b}Four Orbs of Power{/b} from Sensei’s inventory!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Meowri 从 Sensei 的背包里取走了四颗力量宝珠！{/i}

lines.en: : Hey! I worked really hard for those!
lines.zh: : 喂！那些可是我辛辛苦苦才拿到手的！

lines.en: : You sure did! But in order to face the final boss, we need to take them to a special location that only I know about and perform a secret summoning ritual.
lines.zh: : 确实是！但要面对最终 boss，我们得把它们带到只有我知道的一个特殊地点，举行一场秘密的召唤仪式。

lines.en: : Can we not just summon the boss inside this McDonald’s? I’ve been surviving off of Greenis bits for weeks.
lines.zh: : 就不能直接在这家麦当劳里把 boss 召唤出来吗？我已经连着好几个星期靠啃 Greenis 的碎肉活着了。

lines.en: : You’ll be able to eat real food once you defeat the final boss!
lines.zh: : 等你打败最终 boss，就能吃上真正的食物了！

lines.en: : And also, if you die, you have to start the whole game all over.
lines.zh: : 还有，如果你死了，就得从头再玩一遍整款游戏。
: 我得{i}怎么样？{/i}

lines.en: : Yup! So be really careful to not make any mistakes!
lines.zh: : 没错！所以千万要小心，别犯任何错误！

lines.en: : Or just save the game. That works too, I guess.
lines.zh: : 或者你也可以存档。我猜那样也行吧。

lines.en: : I’m never playing another Shiawase Group game for as long as I live.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子都不会再碰任何一款 Shiawase 集团的游戏了。

lines.en: : That just means you can play more Sensei-Quest!
lines.zh: : 那不就意味着你可以玩更多《Sensei 大冒险》了嘛！
: 求你了，什么都行，别是这个。

lines.en: {i}Meowri and Sensei exit Meowri’s house before Meowri transforms into a car!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Meowri 和 Sensei 走出 Meowri 的家，紧接着 Meowri 就变成了一辆车！{/i}

lines.en: : Don’t ask questions! Just get in!
lines.zh: : 别问！快上车！

lines.en: {i}Sensei enters Meowri, but in a way that provides no sexual pleasure to him whatsoever!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Sensei 进入了 Meowri 体内——不过是以一种完全没给他带来任何性快感的方式！{/i}

lines.en: {i}He takes his place in the middle section of the backseat (which does not have a seatbelt) because he is very daring and brave and also kind of weird.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}他在后排中间的位置坐了下来（那个位置没有安全带），因为他非常大胆、非常勇敢，而且还有点奇怪。{/i}

lines.en: : I am a force to be reckoned with.
lines.zh: : 我是一股不容小觑的力量。

lines.en: {i}But then Meowri is T-boned by another vehicle and Sensei takes 50 damage!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}然而 Meowri 随即被另一辆车从侧面撞上，Sensei 受到了 50 点伤害！{/i}
{i}Sensei 死了！{/i}
{i}感谢游玩《Sensei 大冒险》！{/i}
: {size=-15}再坚持一下……{/size}
: {size=-13}然——后……{/size}
: {size=-11}好了！{/size}
: {size=-9}Sensei！你还在吗？{/size}
: {size=-7}快点！醒醒！{/size}
{i}Sensei 复活了！{/i}
: Meowri？……
: 发生什么事了？

lines.en: : We were in a terrible accident! I had to rewrite the game’s ending just to bring you back.
lines.zh: : 我们遭遇了一场可怕的事故！为了把你带回来，我不得不重写了游戏的结局。
: 你感觉怎么样？
: 感觉就像我刚刚死了一样。

lines.en: : Well, you {i}did{/i} just die. But you’re okay now! Or at least...you need to hurry up and {i}get{/i} okay. The final boss will be appearing any second now.
lines.zh: : 呃，你刚刚{i}确实{/i}是死了。不过你现在没事了！或者说……你得赶紧{i}好起来{/i}。最终 boss 随时都可能出现。

lines.en: {i}Sensei gazes up at Meowri. A small sphere hovers and pulsates several inches above her hands, which are currently clasped together as if to receive the Eucharist.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Sensei 抬头望向 Meowri。一颗小球悬在她双手上方几英寸的地方，脉动起伏，而她的双手此刻正合十，像是要领受圣体一般。{/i}
: 那是什么东西？
: 一个崭新的开始。

lines.en: {i}It is at that moment that Sensei realizes what the sphere is — the {b}Four Orbs of Power{/b} fused together into the {b}Ancient Orb.{/b}{/i}
lines.zh: {i}就在那一刻，Sensei 意识到那颗球究竟是什么——{b}四颗力量宝珠{/b}融合而成的{b}远古宝珠。{/b}{/i}

lines.en: : {i}This{/i} is the final boss. {i}This{/i} is what you must defeat if you ever want to see your family again.
lines.zh: : {i}这{/i}就是最终 boss。{i}这{/i}就是你必须打败的东西，否则你再也见不到你的家人。

lines.en: : It’s what you must defeat if you ever want to see {i}anything{/i} again.
lines.zh: : 也是你必须打败的东西，否则你再也见不到{i}任何{/i}东西。

lines.en: : There is a dark entity within each and every one of us — and this one is yours.
lines.zh: : 我们每个人体内都栖息着一个黑暗的实体——而这一颗，是属于你的那个。

lines.en: {i}The sphere begins to rapidly expand in size. Meowri takes a step back as it now hovers on its own, without what little assistance her hands provided before.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}球开始迅速膨胀。Meowri 后退一步，如今它已能自行悬浮，不再需要她双手先前的那点托扶。{/i}
: 祝你好运，英雄。
: 最终决战，现在开始！
{i}宝珠出现了！{/i}
: 我做不到……
: 我办不到……

lines.en: {i}The Orb peers deep into Sensei’s soul, but there is no life left in him to drain.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}宝珠窥视着 Sensei 的灵魂深处，可他体内已经没有可供汲取的生命了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Sensei collapses to the ground, scared and confused.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Sensei 瘫倒在地，恐惧又茫然。{/i}

lines.en: {i}The Orb does not move. But as Sensei begins to fade away, he can faintly make out the sounds of whispers bleeding from the dark entity’s center.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}宝珠没有移动。但当 Sensei 开始消散时，他隐约能听见从那黑暗实体的中心渗出的低语。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But is that what the whispers are actually commanding? Or is that just what he expects to hear?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}可那低语命令的当真是这句话吗？还是说，那只是他自己期待听到的东西？{/i}

lines.en: {i}In his final moments, he changes everything about himself.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在最后的时刻，他改变了自己的一切。{/i}
{i}他变成了一个更好的人。{/i}

lines.en: {i}He finally learns what it is that makes the earth move.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}他终于明白了是什么让大地运转。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But it is too late for belief alone to change anything.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但事到如今，光有信念已经改变不了任何事了。{/i}
{i}Sensei 死了！{/i}

lines.en: {i}His blow is absorbed by the endless void before him.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}他的攻击被眼前那片无尽的虚空吸收了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}The Orb peers deep into Sensei’s soul! It eats away at his mind!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}宝珠窥视着 Sensei 的灵魂深处！它在啃食他的心智！{/i}

lines.zh: {i}他的毒液刺穿了宝珠的外壳。{/i}

lines.en: {i}It is uncertain whether it had any effect...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不确定有没有效果……{/i}

lines.zh: {i}宝珠把它们吸了进去，颜色在一瞬间染成了那片金黄，随后又恢复了原本的模样。{/i}

lines.en: {i}With every inch, Sensei can hear whispers bleeding out of The Orb’s core.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}每靠近一寸，Sensei 都能听见从宝珠核心渗出的低语。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Tendrils spring out of its invisible mouth and tear him limb from limb!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}触手从它那张看不见的嘴里弹射而出，把他撕成了碎片！{/i}
{i}Sensei 受到 2000 点伤害！{/i}

lines.en: : Stop! Please! I’ll leave you alone! I’ll be good! I’ll stay here forever!
lines.zh: : 住手！求你了！我不打扰你了！我会乖乖的！我永远待在这儿！

lines.en: {i}The Orb’s tendrils tear out Sensei’s tongue!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}宝珠的触手撕掉了 Sensei 的舌头！{/i}

lines.zh: {i}错误：Sensei 受到的伤害超出了游戏引擎允许的上限。该操作无效。{/i}

: 你他妈是在跟我开玩笑吗？

lines.en: : ...and so I said to the cashier, “That’s no St. Bernard! That’s my AK47!” And Sana, I swear, you should have seen the {i}look{/i} on her face!
lines.zh: : ……于是我就跟收银员说，「那可不是圣伯纳犬！那是我的 AK47！」Sana，我发誓，你真该看看她当时的{i}表情{/i}！

lines.en: {i}Welcome to the first ever special Halloween update in Lessons in Love!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}欢迎来到《Lessons in Love》首个特别万圣节更新！{/i}

lines.en: {b}{size=+25}THIS IS WHERE YOU’RE MEANT TO BE.{/size}{/b}
lines.zh: {b}{size=+25}这里才是你命中注定该在的地方。{/size}{/b}
: Sensei？

lines.en: : Please tell me that...at least {i}you{/i} came here with me...
lines.zh: : 求你告诉我……至少你是跟我一起{i}来{/i}到这儿的……
: 求你了？……

lines.en: : Come on! Tell a joke already! No one wants to see whatever this weird sketch is!
lines.zh: : 快点啊！讲个笑话吧！没人想看这种莫名其妙的短剧！

lines.en: : Mind your manners, Misty. Lidearel is clearly new to this game. We must remain kind to her so long as the sprout still hangs above her head.
lines.zh: : 注意你的礼貌，Misty。Lidearel 显然刚玩这个游戏。只要她头上还挂着那根新芽，我们就得对她友善。
: 有什么地方……{i}不太对劲。{/i}

lines.en: : What’s wrong, Ayane? You seemed so confident just a minute ago.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Ayane？你一分钟前还那么自信呢。

lines.en: : Classic case of stage fright. Same thing happened to me the first time I played the Whisky.
lines.zh: : 典型的怯场。我第一次在 Whisky 演出的时候也是这样。

lines.en: : Just do it like you practiced. I can’t even remember how many times you made us sit through your rehearsal.
lines.zh: : 就像你排练时那样做就行。我都数不清你逼我们看了多少遍你的彩排。

lines.en: : Maybe she just needs a little encouragement? Everybody! Let’s cheer for Ayane and give her the courage she needs to perform her routine!
lines.zh: : 也许她只是需要一点鼓励？各位！我们一起来给 Ayane 加油，给她完成表演所需要的勇气吧！
: A-ya-ne！A-ya-ne！A-ya-ne！
: 我想回家。

lines.en: : ...and so I said to the cashier, “That’s no St. Bernard! That’s my AK47!” And Sana, I swear, you should have seen the {i}look{/i} on her face!
lines.zh: : ……于是我就跟收银员说，「那可不是圣伯纳犬！那是我的 AK47！」Sana，我发誓，你真该看看她当时的{i}表情{/i}！

lines.en: : Something wrong, Maya? You seem super confused all of a sudden. You don’t think somebody spiked your drink, do you?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Maya？你突然看起来超级困惑。你该不会觉得有人在你的饮料里下了药吧？
: 好奇怪，我……

lines.en: : I could have sworn I was going as Haruhi this year...
lines.zh: : 我明明记得今年我要扮的是 Haruhi……

lines.en: : Haruhi? From that super old anime?
lines.zh: : Haruhi？那部超老的动画里的？

lines.en: : It was a light novel first, but...that’s...not really the point.
lines.zh: : 它原本是轻小说，不过……那……不是重点。

lines.en: : You sure you’re not just misremembering? The manga club decided that we were all going to be dress up as Genshin Impact characters this year. And you were, like, {i}really{/i} adamant about going as Mona.
lines.zh: : 你确定不是自己记错了？漫画社早就定好了，今年我们所有人都要扮成《原神》的角色。而且你当时还{i}特别{/i}坚持要扮 Mona。
: 我……是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...are you sure everything’s okay? Do you want to go lie down or something? I can come with you.
lines.zh: : 是啊……你确定你一切都好吗？要不要去躺一会儿什么的？我可以陪你。
: 我会……
: 其实……
: 好吧……

lines.en: : Let’s...go lie down for a minute.
lines.zh: : 我们……去躺一会儿吧。
